contrastive.explanation: Rejecting F1, F2 would leave no surviving signal and the policy would land on benign — the opposite of the human-review path we chose.

risk.rationale: Verified findings show a phishing email delivered to g.sen@aegean.edu from a suspicious KYK burs domain (F1) and that the user clicked a link to that same domain (F2). This is a consistent, confirmed signal of phishing engagement, so it cannot be dismissed as benign. However, there is no confirmed account takeover chain (no credential submission, no successful login from the phish, no downstream malicious activity), so contain is not supported. The evidence is not conflicting or insufficient, so escalate is not required. Appropriate tier: monitor for follow-on compromise.
